summary: The recovery has broadened: the Nifty has clawed back above 22,700 and more than halved its loss, while small caps edge up even though decliners still lead.

detail.leaders: Nifty Pharma and Healthcare; BSE Smallcap 250 (+0.13%); Electrosteel Castings
detail.laggards: Tata Motors PV, HDFC Life, Bajaj Finance; small-cap breadth is still weak (106 up, 142 down)
detail.tone: Clearly better than 12:00: at noon the Nifty was 22,716.40 (−63.85, −0.28%) and the Sensex 72,555.37 (−216), well off the lows near 22,600. The latest headline has the Nifty holding above 22,700.
